prerequisites: Review the canonical skill instructions. Use the open Skills CLI, compatible YYLO CLI, or standalone Ledger installer.

capabilities.title: Seven procedures, three groups
capabilities.summary: Discover Ledger Records, planning and bounded execution skills.
details: Four skills operate standalone Ledger: ledger-tasks-yylo, wiki-yylo, workflow-yylo and artifact-yylo. Understand-project and planning precede the explicitly requested one-task Ralph loop.
Skills are independently versioned instructions, not a fourth runtime system. Full instructions remain in the canonical tagged repository.
commands:
npx skills add yylo-dev/yylo-skills
npx skills add yylo-dev/yylo-skills --skill wiki-yylo
capabilities.boundary: Skills cannot grant execution, publication or production authority. Review them like code.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.
